fonts.display: 'switzer', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'signifier', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cerulean Sky
palette.role: Full-bleed canvas for hero and atmospheric sections, primary nav background, sky-illustration base

palette.name: Deep Cerulean
palette.role: Tinted shadow color — the brand-blue cast on every elevation shadow makes even drop shadows feel atmospheric

palette.name: Atmosphere Blue
palette.role: Outlined action border — secondary buttons and card outlines gain a cool sky tint instead of neutral gray

palette.name: Midnight Navy
palette.role: Primary filled action background — the Get Started pill, pressed against the sky, reads as a deep horizon line

palette.name: Berry Red
palette.role: Single chromatic accent — reserved for emphasis ink, important markers, and the occasional stamp of urgency against the blue

palette.name: Cloud White
palette.role: Primary surface for cards, product UI, testimonial panels — the white that floats against the sky

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Subtle card background for nested surfaces, the lightest gray still distinct from pure white

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Hairline borders and dividers — the only neutral border color in the system

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Muted helper text and secondary metadata

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Tertiary text, icon fills, low-emphasis labels

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Body text and dominant UI strokes — the dark that anchors serif type against white cards

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Deepest text tone, used sparingly for highest-emphasis body copy with a barely-warm purple undertone
